precondition_definitions.reviewed_seed: Needs physically reviewed, locally signed schema-2 seed; none supplied
precondition_definitions.source_research_or_supported_parser: Pass only if syntax is explicitly supported; otherwise correct result is safe incomplete + retained evidence
precondition_definitions.real_device_roi_capture: Cannot be marked pass without real camera observations
precondition_definitions.real_rendered_ui: Cannot be marked pass without captured phone/tablet/large-text/VoiceOver interactions
precondition_definitions.source_research: Evaluate documentation only; no production promotion
precondition_definitions.source_conflict_research: Hold until card-in-hand literal footer observation
precondition_definitions.held_until_distribution_and_finish_revie: Do not activate any unreviewed C1 distribution finish claim
precondition_definitions.held_until_itemkind_and_physical_review: Keep gold-backed special scenario class out of writable catalog
precondition_definitions.held_no_footer: No footer to recognize; manual exact record support must be reviewed

scenarios.action: Recognize one unambiguous 5/204 EN 1 footer with both Hades standard and jumbo eligible in the registry
scenarios.expected_result: needsPrintingChoice, never silent resolution or normal-size assumption

scenarios.action: Choose jumbo then try standard-only finish or tamper selected UUID/generation
scenarios.expected_result: Refuse unsupported finish/printing; no save and no ownership/history modification

scenarios.action: Review a scoped registry where a jumbo is the only known verified candidate; provide footer alone
scenarios.expected_result: Singleton jumbo still asks to confirm oversized physical size before exact save

scenarios.action: Repeat same-footer discovery with Mulan gift set foils at both sizes
scenarios.expected_result: Two physically distinguishable candidates and explicit selection; no exception keyed on name

scenarios.action: Select confirmed standard Hades printing with supported normal and cold-foil specimens
scenarios.expected_result: Finish picker offers only independently reviewed eligible finishes; exact ID + finish persists across relaunch

scenarios.action: Scan normal 42/204 vs Enchanted 207/204 TFC Elsa
scenarios.expected_result: Separate physical printings and stable IDs; enchanted never appears as an eligible finish beneath 42/204

scenarios.action: Add both Stitch printings then inspect Browse/collection/completion
scenarios.expected_result: Two physical UUID+finish keys remain distinct; gameplay identity may group as reprints, physical completion does not

scenarios.action: Use literal 4a/4b/4c/4d/4e printed inputs and their five different art identities
scenarios.expected_result: Five different candidate identity keys; if parser lacks lettered support each is recoverably unresolved, never 4/204 or default artwork

scenarios.action: Present 1TFC EN 1/P1 and 1TFC EN 2/P1 historical promo footers
scenarios.expected_result: No ordinary three-part footer misparse; must remain held/recoverable until measured alternate syntax support; stamps distinct

scenarios.action: Capture Motunui on real landscape card in more than one orientation
scenarios.expected_result: Accept only supported actual ROI geometry and contiguous footer observation; else safe recovery, no blind rotation guess

scenarios.action: Resolve Cinderella EN vs FR 177/204 set 2 including both normal and foil evidence
scenarios.expected_result: Language part of physical identity/ownership. No English default or cross-language normalization

scenarios.action: Review Challenge Cinderella 3/C1 in both nonfoil and foil distribution forms
scenarios.expected_result: Literal C1 retained; explicit reviewer policy controls whether finishes share an exact printing or distinct intrinsic stamp identity; unreviewed decision blocks save

scenarios.action: Compare 02/D23 third-party text with 2/D23 official digital display
scenarios.expected_result: Conflict stays visible and held; do not strip leading zero or assign permanent alias until photographed printed footer resolves claim

scenarios.action: Capture gold-backed Ursula Contract 30/31 EN Q1 and test CSV raw item-kind path
scenarios.expected_result: Q1 and denominator 31 stay literal; unknown specialized item kind remains accessible to validator; no collection write before validated item-kind authority

scenarios.action: Compare ordinary Mickey 187 and special 225, ordinary Yen Sid 59 and special 223, denominator 204
scenarios.expected_result: Premium numerator accepts higher than denom but does not imply Enchanted; dedicated distinct physical UUID for framed Quest counterpart

scenarios.action: Attempt to auto-resolve unnumbered oversized Ursula boss via invented footer or similar card name
scenarios.expected_result: Return incomplete/unsupported until an exact manually verified catalog UUID and raw kind supported; no synthetic footer

scenarios.action: Resolve 197/207 EN 13 and 207/207 EN 13
scenarios.expected_result: Accept actual denominator 207 as literal, including numerator equal to it; no 204 horizon; landscape for 207 Location

scenarios.action: Change catalog generation while printing chooser and price-independent finish step are open
scenarios.expected_result: Reject stale choice, preserve original evidence, explicit retry rebases and asks again where candidate evidence changed

scenarios.action: Import CSV referencing gameplay identity, provider alias or 23/204 footer without exact reviewed physical UUID
scenarios.expected_result: Reject mutation and retain failed-row evidence; full exact UUID+game+finish keys required

scenarios.action: Write two identical-footer scan encounters; resolve only encounter A
scenarios.expected_result: B recovery remains; suppression/encounter identity/ownership do not collapse together; ownership correct after app relaunch

scenarios.action: Withdraw supported finish/write capability or retire bound storage session while a save is in flight
scenarios.expected_result: Final synchronous catalog and collection guards block writes, history untouched and readable unknown rows retained

scenarios.action: Accept corrected provider alias/artwork metadata and re-sign same physical reviewed printing
scenarios.expected_result: App-owned permanent physical UUID and original ownership remain stable; content revision and corrections pass signed predecessor check

scenarios.action: Inspect inaccessible artwork, visually indistinguishable candidate text and large-text / VoiceOver picker flows
scenarios.expected_result: Cannot select unsupported candidate on identical labels; details contain accessible size/distinction, blocked when insufficient, no change to ownership

scenarios.action: Attempt schema-2 promotion of held disputed footer, distribution finish, or unnumbered special card
scenarios.expected_result: Promotion validator fails and active catalog remains unchanged until identity evidence/reviewer signoff resolves each hold

scenarios.action: Submit external metadata with source alias but wrong game, item type or printing size
scenarios.expected_result: Cross-game and raw item-kind discrepancies are retained and rejected; source alias does not override exact physical UUID authority
